metadata.title: When Valorant said ‘Sure, why not?’ and I accidentally got 2 kills LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did my aim just take a coffee break and still hit 2 kills?
Enemy looked like they forgot it was a shooter.
Click if your best plays are pure accidental chaos!

Tap in if your kills shouldn’t have worked but you’re flexing anyway!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
